nodes.label: FMU_FORGE_DIR Include Path Override
nodes.rationale: The FMI tests include fmu-forge headers directly rather than through a Chrono target, so the fmu-forge top-level directory must be added to each test's include path. The variable FMU_FORGE_DIR is used instead of a hard-coded in-tree submodule path so that a user override of the fmu-forge location is honored.

edges.source_location: Both post-process targets created by a higher-level helper with target_include_directories / target_compile_definitions rather than declaring the target inline
